description.zh: 服务提供者IP，支持模糊查询。
description.en: The IP address of the service provider. Fuzzy searches are supported.

description.zh:
数据来源，取值如下：

- agent：新版服务查询需要传递。
- registry：旧版服务查询传递。
description.en:
The source of the data. Valid values:

*   agent: Use this value if you use the service query feature of the latest version to pass the query result.
*   registry: Use this value if you use the service query feature of the earlier version to pass the query result.
The number of the page to return.

description.zh: 注册类型。已废弃，无需设置。
description.en: The type of the service registry. This parameter is deprecated. You can ignore it.
The ID of the service. This parameter is deprecated. You can ignore it.
The number of entries returned per page.
The source of the service. Set the value to edas.

title.zh: 查询微服务消费者列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas get-service-consumers-page --biz-region cn-hangzhou --namespace cn-hangzhou:doc-test --origin agent --service-type dubbo --app-id efbda488-7b33-432f-a40d-000000470000 --source edas --service-id com.alibabacloud.hipstershop.CartService --service-name com.alibabacloud.hipstershop.CartService --service-version 1.0.0 --group DUBBO --ip 10.20.x.xx --registry-type nacos --page 0 --size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
